claim.claim-text: 1. A station in a wireless network, the station comprising:
one or more memories; and one or more processors coupled to the one or more memories, the one or more processors configured to cause:

receiving a PPDU, Physical layer Protocol Data Unit, including a BSS, basic service set, color value and a color indication, wherein the BSS color value identifies a first BSS, receiving a VHT, Very High Throughput, PPDU, wherein the VHT PPDU comprises a partial AID, Association Identifier, and determining whether the VHT PPDU is transmitted from the first BSS based on the partial AID and the BSS Color value when the color indication has a first value.
2. The station of claim 1, further comprising:

comparing a part of the partial AID of the VHT PPDU with a part of the BSS color value of the PPDU, and determining that the VHT PPDU is transmitted from the first BSS when the part of the partial AID of the VHT PPDU is equal to the part of the BSS color value of the PPDU.
3. The station of claim 1, further comprising:

comparing a part of the partial AID of the VHT PPDU with a part of the BSS color value of the PPDU, and determining that the VHT PPDU is transmitted from a second BSS when the part of the partial AID of the VHT PPDU is not equal to the part of the BSS color value of the PPDU.
4. The station of claim 1, wherein the partial AIDS identifies a BSS which the VHT PPDU belongs to when the color indication has the first value.
5. The station of claim 1, wherein the BSS color value is present in a Beacon frame, a Probe response frame, or an association response frame included in the PPDU.
6. The station of claim 1, wherein the partial AID is in a signal field of the VHT PPDU.
7. An Access Point, AP, in a wireless network, the AP comprising:
one or more memories; and one or more processors coupled to the one or more memories, the one or more processors configured to cause:

transmitting a PPDU, Physical layer Protocol Data Unit, including a BSS, basic service set, color value and a color indication, wherein the BSS color value identifies a first BSS, and transmitting a VHT, Very High Throughput, PPDU, wherein the VHT PPDU comprises a partial AID, Association Identifier, wherein a part of the partial AID of the VHT PPDU is equal to a part of the BSS color value of the PPDU when the VHT PPDU is transmitted from the first BSS.
8. The AP of claim 7, wherein the part of the partial AID of the VHT PPDU is not equal to the part of the BSS color value of the PPDU when the VHT PPDU is transmitted from a second BSS.
9. The AP of claim 7, wherein the partial AIDS identifies a BSS which the VHT PPDU belongs to when the color indication has the first value.
10. The AP of claim 7, wherein the BSS color value is present in a Beacon frame, a Probe response frame, or an association response frame included in the PPDU.
11. The station of claim 7, wherein the partial AID is in a signal field of the VHT PPDU.
